book.twin_definition: real twin (venue positions × Δmid, price leg) minus paper target book priced at the venue moment (+25 min), bps of realized gross per anchor; >0 = real beat paper

method: Tiers: device COST_B order; qv4h = expm1(mean over the trailing 2016 5-minute bars of log1p(5m quote volume)) x 48, computed per anchor from the producer's own ~/wide_shadow/state/rolling.npz (ch3) exactly as shadow_loop_v3.py / w10_universe_recheck.py tier_of do; verified against the producer's sel_idx at 09-05 04Z (233/233). Each traded symbol is tiered by its own qv4h at its anchor. Set: 'steady' = 51 combo anchors 08-26 04Z..09-05 00Z excluding the 6 leverage-ramp/deposit step-up anchors (|dgross|>15%) and the halted/flattened 08-26 12Z/16Z (all_calib = 57 anchors, in alternatives). Fees: USDT fee_paid from /fapi/v1/userTrades (= commission_BNB x BNB mid, exact on 6908/6908 rows); maker 1.80 / taker 4.50 bps everywhere. maker_bps = maker fee - notional-weighted maker fill improvement vs the executor's mid_at_anchor (bookTicker mid at N+24m, the pricing moment), per tier, winsorised at +-100 bps per fill, 100% coverage; taker_bps = taker fee - the same for taker top-ups, POOLED across tiers (per-tier taker samples are 148-356 fills with heavy tails; per-tier values are in components). Positive slippage in components = filled better than the anchor mid. This vector excludes the 24-minute timing decay between the nominal 4h grid and the executor's pricing moment (paper nominal minus paper shifted 25 min = +2.85 bps per anchor here), which the device treats separately, and excludes the never-filled residual, whose effect is in book.twin_bps_per_anchor (real minus paper, price leg). markout60_bps (+60 s post-fill drift) is reported, not consumed: it is a 5% non-random backfill sample and, being post-fill, is common to paper and real books. CI95 are anchor-level bootstraps. Alternatives (fee only; fee minus markout; device default) are listed under 'alternatives'.
